const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab reorient_red_mug controller helpers and episode sequence."""
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/output"
+
+
+class Controller:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.r = Robot()
+        self.spec = self.r.spec()
+
+    def status(self):
+        s = self.r.status()
+        print(json.dumps(s))
+        return s
+
+    def observe(self, tag="obs", depth=True):
+        o = self.r.get_obs(depth=depth, video="none")
+        for cam, img in o.last.items():
+            Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"{tag}_{cam}.png"))
+        if depth:
+            for cam, d in o.last_depth.items():
+                np.save(os.path.join(OUT, f"{tag}_{cam}_depth.npy"), d)
+        with open(os.path.join(OUT, f"{tag}_meta.json"), "w") as f:
+            json.dump(o.meta, f, indent=2)
+        print("obs", tag, "step", o.meta.get("control_steps"), "time_left", o.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+        return o
+
+    def pose(self):
+        o = self.r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
+        now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        return now[8:15], now[:7], now
+
+    def ik(self, pose, seed=None):
+        if seed is None:
+            _, seed, _ = self.pose()
+        ans = self.r.ik({"tcp": list(map(float, pose))}, seed=seed)
+        print("ik", ans)
+        return ans
+
+    def joints_to(self, q_target, grip=None, seconds=2.0, note="trajectory"):
+        tcp, q0, now = self.pose()
+        q_target = np.asarray(q_target, dtype=float)[:7]
+        if grip is None:
+            grip = 1.0 if now[15] > 0.5 else 0.0
+        dt = 1.0 / 15.0
+        n = max(2, int(np.ceil(seconds / dt)))
+        a = np.empty((n, 8), dtype=np.float32)
+        for i, f in enumerate(np.linspace(1/n, 1, n)):
+            a[i, :7] = q0 + f * (q_target - q0)
+            a[i, 7] = grip
+        res = self.r.submit("joint_position", a, dt=dt, video="none", note=note)
+        print("move", note, "done", res.done, "reason", res.meta.get("reason"),
+              "rows", res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"), "tcp", res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[8:15])
+        return res
+
+    def move_pose(self, pose, grip=None, seconds=2.0, note="pose"):
+        ans = self.ik(pose)
+        if not ans.get("ok"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed: {ans}")
+        if grip is None:
+            _, _, now = self.pose()
+            grip = 1.0 if now[15] > 0.5 else 0.0
+        return self.joints_to(ans["q"], grip=grip, seconds=seconds, note=note)
+
+
+def main():
+    """Full execution is intentionally staged so each grasp/lift can be observed."""
+    c = Controller()
+    c.status()
+    c.observe("initial")
+    return c
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
